verdict.rationale: Neon documents webhooks only within its Managed Better Auth module — for authentication events like sign-up/login, enabling custom server logic and replacing email delivery channels — with per-branch isolated auth environments for testing. There's no evidence of a general-purpose webhook subscription system covering broader platform events (branch creation, project lifecycle, compute state changes), which would matter for an AI-native/agentic workflow. Missing for 10: platform-wide event webhook catalog, payload/signing documentation, and evidence of subscribing to non-auth events like branch or compute state changes.
